title: Guaiacol counters renal fibrosis via BMP/ERK/Smad1/5/9 signaling in UUO-induced chronic kidney disease.
authors: Kulkarni, Hrushikesh Vikas; Gaikwad, Anil Bhanudas
one_liner_zh: 该文研究愈创木酚通过BMP/ERK/Smad信号通路缓解肾纤维化，属于疾病治疗机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is characterized by progressive fibrosis and inflammation, with limited therapeutic options. Natural compounds have been studied for their potential to offer kidney-protective benefits, especially in CKD. Guaiacol, a lignin-based polyphenol and one of the key constituents of Angelica sinensis (Oliv.) Diels has been shown to have anti-oxidative and anti-inflammatory properties. Hence, we aimed to inspect and analyze the potential of guaiacol in the unexplored realm of renal fibrosis, integrating computational pharmacology and validating the outcomes in an experimental in-vitro recombinant human-transforming growth factor-beta 1 (rh-TGF-beta1)-induced rat renal epithelial cells and in-vivo model of unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO) in Wistar rats. Targets for CKD, as well as guaiacol, were first recognized using target databases, and the common targets were subsequently evaluated to elucidate their interactions through a protein-protein interaction network. Furthermore, network analyses using software such as Cytoscape and STRING led to the identification of critical hub proteins, which were subsequently subjected to gene ontology and pathway enrichment analyses. The core targets, as well as anti-fibrotic proteins, exhibited strong binding affinity with guaiacol, as evidenced by molecular docking studies. In-vitro studies revealed guaiacol's anti-inflammatory potential by downregulation of ACE and p-NF-kappaB levels, reinforcing computational predictions. Furthermore, animal experimentation revealed that guaiacol administration, over 21 days, significantly mitigated renal structural and functional parameters, as demonstrated by both biochemical and histopathological findings. Furthermore, immunohistochemical analyses revealed that guaiacol inhibited the expression of key fibrotic proteins, including collagen, fibronectin, and alpha-smooth muscle actin, which were significantly elevated in the unilateral ureteral obstruction group. Additionally, guaiacol notably reduced the phosphorylation of ERK and Smad1/5/9 proteins, along with Smad4, highlighting its therapeutic potential in renal fibrosis via modulation of the RAAS, NF-kappaB-mediated inflammation, and BMP/Smad1/5/9 anti-fibrotic signaling axis.
abstract_zh: 慢性肾脏病（CKD）以进行性纤维化和炎症为特征，治疗选择有限。天然化合物因其在CKD中可能提供肾脏保护益处的潜力而受到研究。愈创木酚（Guaiacol），一种基于木质素的多酚，是当归（Angelica sinensis (Oliv.) Diels）的关键成分之一，已被证明具有抗氧化和抗炎特性。因此，我们旨在通过整合计算药理学，并在实验性体外重组人转化生长因子-β1（rh-TGF-beta1）诱导的大鼠肾上皮细胞和Wistar大鼠单侧输尿管梗阻（UUO）体内模型中验证结果，来检查和分析愈创木酚在肾纤维化未探索领域中的潜力。首先使用靶点数据库识别CKD和愈创木酚的靶点，随后评估共同靶点，通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络阐明其相互作用。此外，使用Cytoscape和STRING等软件进行网络分析，识别关键枢纽蛋白，随后对这些蛋白进行基因本体论和通路富集分析。核心靶点以及抗纤维化蛋白与愈创木酚表现出强结合亲和力，这通过分子对接研究得到证实。体外研究显示，愈创木酚通过下调ACE和p-NF-kappaB水平发挥抗炎潜力，强化了计算预测。此外，动物实验表明，愈创木酚给药21天显著缓解了肾脏结构和功能参数，这通过生化和组织病理学发现得到证实。进一步地，免疫组织化学分析显示，愈创木酚抑制了关键纤维化蛋白的表达，包括胶原蛋白、纤连蛋白和α-平滑肌肌动蛋白，这些蛋白在单侧输尿管梗阻组中显著升高。此外，愈创木酚显著降低了ERK和Smad1/5/9蛋白的磷酸化，以及Smad4，突显了其通过调节RAAS、NF-kappaB介导的炎症和BMP/Smad1/5/9抗纤维化信号轴在肾纤维化中的治疗潜力。
